column2: The Wheel turns for you. Each kind of harm you suffer teaches your body to endure it, until it can no longer harm you. Every new kind of harm you adapt to gives you +50% max health and +50% damage, compounding.
Press your summon key (Mod settings) to call your own Mahoraga, or to dismiss him. He fights everything but you, shares your adaptations and the techniques they unlock.
Press your Divine Dogs key (Mod settings) to call the white Divine Dog, and again to send it back. Every 50 kills or any boss kill it grows: the black dog joins, then both merge into Totality.
